title: 2027 League Preview
author: Tommy L
paragraphs: When I think of this league, this thing of ours as it were, the first thing I think of is acceptance.
But seriously! Hear me out here.

Our league commissioner has the weirdest Twitter algorithm ever recorded, shares that fact with us every day, and we accept that! Not everyone enjoys it, but we’ve come to know this as part of our routine. (And no, I don’t enjoy it for the record, I work in politics and I still don’t care, but I accept it).

We are comprised of 76ers, Celtics and Heat fans and we hear the worst homer takes because of it, and it’s all part of the acceptance game. We’ve all come to the conclusion of this being a magnificent NBA season ahead of us, and we can chalk up Pritchard All-NBA and Klay Isn’t Washed takes to pure excitement. It’s acceptable behavior for a league on our sicko level.

On a personal note, you random golf bros and other 30s working professionals accepted me a few years back, and recently accepted the big homie BLD into the family. For this, I appreciate y’all. I couldn’t imagine my life without checking if Seth cheated his lineup again or “Celtics?” texts after a MazzBall blowout. In a world that has become increasingly insular, you didn’t have to bring in an outsider, and you did so anyways. Now it is time to return the favor and make a playoff run to really get on y’all level.

But enough about me, everyone has a reason to be excited this year! Well, maybe not young Jacob, who should probably accept his fate as ass. He should probably just watch the Celtics, ditto for Jordan and the 76ers. Everyone else is fair game, at least for a playoff spot.

Well, two of the four spots anyways, since we handed Derek a super team, and Seth handed one to himself! Luckily, I’ll have the league know that I’ve used my connections and gotten Pablo Torre on the case of the Jalen Johnson 1u contract and dubious KAT extension. Many are saying this would strip the commissioner of a title were he to win this year, I’ve heard it from the best people.

Personally, I’d love to see a playoff field of Seth against the Summer Semester trio of myself, Derek and Bones (a real Triangle), but I can easily see Andrew sneaking his way into a slot like Kyle Pitts sneaking off with $54 million.

Let’s see, who else do I have to mention? Well, Diaz will have better luck in his new foreign league for starters. J&J are two years away from being two years away. And Nate? He’s too busy looking at golf influencer titties to compete this year.

So, I’m glad we’ve all accepted each other for our strengths, our flaws, our big flaws (get that politics shit off the timeline!!) and our biggest flaws, like trading Steph Castle in his second season. Cheers to hoops!
P.S. I didn’t really mean that acceptance shit when it comes to Jake, hate that guy
